_written: 2026-11-02, before fig3.py was run. Grant figure 3 (LDLR truth-set validation), assembled from panels already built and reviewed in this project; no new statistics. Figure 1 on hold (draft 7), Figure 2 at draft 4.
framing: truth sets rather than an activator/repressor pair (grant review, earlier in this session): c.-156C>T is not used as a repressor example (likely Hia5 sequence artifact: C>A gains the same footprint, C>G loses it); repressor appears only as candidate categories in the classification bars
cell_lines: HepG2 run 3 for MPRA and plasmid Fiber-seq; HEK293T only in panel e, as a separate axis (never pooled or overlaid)

sources.a: results/r01_figure_20261102/fig_A_v9/panel_a.tsv (fig_A.py): HepG2 MPRA log2 effect per SNV (633), ClinVar class; regulatory sites as fig_A.SITES (SP-like 89-100, SREBP 127-136, SP1/KLF 143-151; oligo coords, c. = oligo - 285); TSS c.-86
sources.b: fig_A_v9/panel_b_regions.tsv: share of each region's SNVs in each readout's top 20% (element-wide expectation 20%); figA_rules.json marks this panel post hoc / exploratory (region medians had been viewed)
sources.c: fig_A_v9/panel_c_site.tsv: Sp1 site (oligo 143-151, 27 SNVs) change in molecules with a >= 81-bp protected stretch (pts, 95% CI = 1.96 x se) vs MPRA; Spearman from correlations_v2/pairs.tsv (act vs nuc_D_pts, subset sp1_site_143_151)
sources.d: panel_b_v2/panel_b_counts.tsv (fig_panel_b.py, classify.py, |log2| >= 0.5): mechanism category by ClinVar class; 'Repressor gained' / 'Repressor lost' relabelled as candidates
sources.e: fig_A_v9/panel_d_hek.tsv: HepG2 vs HEK293T local inaccessibility change (adenines within 10 bp, pts), SNVs with >= 3 HEK293T clones (113); Spearman and 95% CI from correlations_v2/pairs.tsv (local_inacc_pts vs hek_local_pts, subset all)

style: as Figure 2: one Illustrator-editable SVG (Arial live text via Arimo layout, expand_fonts), PDF/PNG via rsvg-convert with fonts.conf; no draft stamp on the figure (commit and date in summary.json)

layout_draft5._written: 2026-11-02, after the user asked to rethink panels a/b against the grant's multi-modal and calibration aims; before draft 5 was computed. The flag rule is a display choice made after the region view (draft 4) and a read-only preview of control counts had been seen (post hoc, descriptive).

panels.a: unchanged (MPRA along the promoter, five shaded regions)
panels.b: control-variant detection matrix: columns = ClinVar P/LP SNVs (8) then B/LB SNVs (6), 5'->3' within each group, HGVS c. and region name; rows = MPRA (HepG2), Plasmid Fiber-seq (HepG2), AlphaGenome (HepG2), PromoterAI, and 'Any readout'
panels.c: element-wide MPRA x Fiber-seq map: all designed SNVs, ClinVar classes by panel-a markers; dashed lines at each readout's flag cutoff; counts per quadrant (both / MPRA only / Fiber-seq only / neither)
panels.d: HepG2 vs HEK293T local inaccessibility (former e, unchanged); the mechanism-category bars (former d) are dropped from the main figure

layout_draft5.flag_rule: a readout flags a variant when its |score| is in that readout's top 20% across all 633 designed SNVs (quantile 0.8, >=), the same budget for every readout; scores as fig_A.py: MPRA |log2|; Fiber-seq max(|nucleosome-size z|, max |footprint z| over A7 confident fp_features); AlphaGenome max(|DNase|/SD, |LDLR RNA|/SD), HepG2; PromoterAI |score| (MANE ENST00000558518.6)
layout_draft5.direction: per cell, the sign of the component that set the score: MPRA log2 effect; Fiber-seq signed z of the dominant component (+ = more protection); AlphaGenome signed standardized DNase or RNA; PromoterAI score. Shown as an up/down glyph (readout value higher / lower than WT)
layout_draft5.margin: per readout: P/LP flagged x/8, B/LB flagged y/6, share of gnomAD-observed SNVs flagged (all 107 are rare; max AF 0.0011), against 20% for all SNVs
layout_draft5.panel_c_axes: x = MPRA log2 effect; y = Fiber-seq signed z of the dominant component (same quantity as the flag)

layout_draft6._written: 2026-11-03, after the user asked for a version without the A9 z-scores ('Yes, draft 6'); before draft 6 was computed. Post hoc: the control flags for this measure were seen in an exploratory check (ANALYSIS_LOG 2026-11-03).
layout_draft6.fiber_seq_readout: nucleosome-sized protection change = 100 x (share of the SNV's molecules with a confident >= 81-bp call with midpoint in the element - the same share in WT molecules), A7 mask applied to both sides (gnomad_check/nucleosome_all.tsv, mask A7, calls confident, endpoint nucleosome: occ_variant - wt_occ). Plain difference: no labeling adjustment, no standard error, no z. Footprint component (fp_features max |z|) dropped.
layout_draft6.direction: up = more molecules with a nucleosome-sized protected stretch than WT (less accessible); the row and panel c axis are labelled with this meaning
layout_draft6.unchanged: MPRA, AlphaGenome and PromoterAI scores; top 20% |effect| flag rule; columns; margin; panels a and d
layout_draft6.panel_c_axes: y = the nucleosome-sized protection change (percentage points)
layout_draft6.min_molecules: post hoc, 2026-11-03 after the first draft 6 render showed 222T>C at -29 pts: the Fiber-seq readout needs >= 100 variant molecules (else missing, not flagged). Excludes 222T>C (1 molecule) and 176G>A (14) plus 160A>G (0, already missing); the next smallest SNV has 248, so any minimum from 15 to 248 gives the same set. No control SNV is affected.

layout_draft7._written: 2026-11-03, after the user's draft 6 review (panel a crowded; 'flagged' unclear; arrows not interpretable without naming the quantity; drop panel d); before draft 7 was computed. Display changes; the AlphaGenome split changes which SNVs are flagged and is post hoc (the combined row had been seen).
layout_draft7.panel_a: ClinVar classes by Okabe-Ito colour and distinct shape, white edges, drawn in order not in ClinVar < VUS < conflicting < B/LB < P/LP: not in ClinVar small grey dots, VUS small sky-blue dots, conflicting amber filled triangles, B/LB bluish-green filled circles, P/LP vermillion filled diamonds
layout_draft7.panel_b_rows: grouped by the quantity measured, variant - WT: Expression = MPRA (measured, HepG2 log2), AlphaGenome RNA (predicted, LDLR RNA-seq LFC, HepG2), PromoterAI (predicted promoter activity); Accessibility = plasmid Fiber-seq (measured: % of molecules without a confident >= 81-bp protected stretch in the element, i.e. minus the draft 6 nucleosome-share change, >= 100 molecules), AlphaGenome DNase (predicted, 501-bp DIFF_LOG2_SUM, HepG2); then Any readout
layout_draft7.flag_rule: unchanged: |variant - WT| in that row's top 20% of the 633 designed SNVs; wording 'large change', not 'flagged' (it is not a pathogenicity call)
layout_draft7.cells: large increase = up triangle, large decrease = down triangle (ink); smaller change = small grey dot; Any readout = filled square
layout_draft7.panel_c: MPRA expression change x Fiber-seq accessibility change (same sign as panel b), full width
